title: Title & Registration Services Return Notice Charge on a Late-Registration Penalty
content:
A return notice charge is added to a Title & Registration Services late-registration penalty: fifteen dollars (15.00) when the order carries three or more returns from the state, ten dollars (10.00) when it carries exactly two, and nothing when it carries fewer.

The returns counted are all state rejection entries on the title order, whatever their reason, the fee-shortage return included.

| State returns on the order | Return notice charge |
|---|---|
| 1 | nothing |
| 2 | 10.00 |
| 3 | 15.00 |
| 4 or more | 15.00 |

## Hypothetical illustration

An order returned first for a missing signature and then for a fee shortage of no amount carries two returns, so 10.00 is added to the late-registration penalty.
